title: Oscar and the Vow
author: Juniper Dravenmoor
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
